items.text: Reader Arena brings weekly and all-time reading rankings, no matter which genres you read
A new card on your Profile shows your place in this week’s reading race and when it resets
The rankings now have a completely new animated Arena experience
Your companion checks whether a photo really shows a book page before using it, and asks you to retake an unrelated or unreadable photo
Your companion now says plainly when it cannot see a page or does not know a chapter, instead of guessing
A 30-minute daily reading allowance now follows you across books, with a warm prototype-limit message and a one-tap email to request more time
Deleted books move to a recovery bin in Settings; restore the book with its chapters, saved gems and conversation recap, or permanently delete the archived data
Book tiles now use distinct colour palettes, show the title you entered, and open from anywhere on the tile except their dedicated Author, Play and Delete controls
Hands-free voice classification retries brief temporary service failures and gives a clear fallback notice instead of silently dropping the detected speech
Today's reading allowance is included in account snapshots when cloud sync is enabled
Help & Guide now explains voice wake-up, quiet reading, the daily allowance and restoring deleted books, with matching animated walkthroughs
Technical documentation now maps the reading session, voice-classification, storage and recovery flows, including the device and service limits
Help & Support is now far more accurate. It knows every screen and button in the app, and it can tell you which update introduced a feature
Animations inside the Help chat now show fully and neatly on small phones, in light and dark themes
Search a book finds the right book more reliably, including books whose original title is in another language, and never mixes up covers or authors
Search a book lets you choose between editions, with cover, publisher, year, language and whether chapters are available
Search a book shows clearer progress steps in the right order, with a new searching animation
Mind Map gems now always stay linked to their own book
A refreshed Profile card with a calmer look, photo cropping, and an avatar picker that opens when you tap it
Corrected the release date shown for this version in Release History
Small behind-the-scenes reliability and polish improvements
Help & Support actions (New chat, Chat history, App tour) now live as neat icon buttons in the header, so nothing covers the chat
Help chat now explains release labels (Major update, UI enhancement, A new chapter, Signature update) and every Your Reports stage correctly, with matching animations
Hinglish questions in Help chat get Hinglish answers
Help & Support status is now a compact pill, the toolbar is tidier, and the chat uses a simple Send button instead of a mic
Help chat animations now reliably appear under answers, and the chat replies in your language: English, Hindi or Hinglish
If notifications were blocked, a friendly banner explains how to turn them back on for your device
Help chat shows dedicated animations for every app feature and setting, picked by the AI to match your question
You get a push notification when the status of an issue you reported changes
Every gem card now has its own colour
The bottom-dock Profile icon is a perfect circle again
Mind Map full screen works again
The Done step in the report timeline stays grey until the issue is actually done
Your Reports only shows reports you submitted yourself, never content from anyone else
Push notifications deliver app updates and important announcements to your phone's notification tray
Smart study reminders learn when you usually read and nudge you shortly before that time, with an opt-in toggle in Settings
Fixed-in versions on your reports are now links that open the matching Release History entry
Help & Support shows whether the AI assistant is online, with a friendly note telling you to expect a live AI answer or built-in guide answers
The report status timeline has been redesigned with animated progress, and completed stages now show a tick instead of a clock
Back now goes exactly one step up from nested screens, sheets and dialogs instead of leaving the whole section
Ghost Mode now switches on quietly; your companion only explains it when you ask, and points app questions to Help & guide
Help & Support opens with the message box ready straight away, and the blinking cursor next to your name is gone
The Help & Support message box stays visible just above the keyboard while you type
Gem details are no longer clipped; every card, including Real-life application, scrolls fully into view
Mind Map shows the animated dotted connection lines between linked gems across books again
Chapter vocabulary lists scroll again so every difficult word is reachable
Edited status notes no longer appear twice; each stage shows only its latest note

releases.title: Reading Companion, a whole new chapter

items.text: Google sign-in now keeps your reading profile, library progress, saved gems and preferences backed up to your account
Skip Tour speaks the exact onboarding prompt, then your companion responds to the genres you choose
Persistent service notices explain connection issues, while voice-key failures recover in the same reading session when possible
Vocabulary now includes everyday or formal-literary labels, optional sentence practice, gentle recall and private pronunciation observations
Mind Map can connect related ideas across books with cached semantic insights, a three-link limit and an offline fallback
Help & Support is now a full-screen support chat with instant answers, streamed replies, animated guides, saved conversations and direct screen actions
A replayable, bilingual app tour shows how to start reading, save words and quotes, and find key screens
New chat, Chat history and App tour are directly accessible, with searchable date-grouped history, a mobile bottom sheet and a clear return to your current chat
Saved help conversations are clearly read-only, chat deletion requires confirmation and clearing history preserves your current conversation
The welcome tour now points readers to chat with Help & support from Profile
Help gives clearer camera and reading-control answers, with a notice when replies use the backup AI provider
A dedicated Account screen brings your connected Google account and live cloud-sync controls together
Gems are easier to search and browse by book, while saved memories are organized by recency with clearer editing controls
Re-sync brings an off-topic reply back to the current book and chapter using recent conversation context
Report an issue can polish your description and reproduction steps while preserving the original meaning and step count
Profile and Settings now keep avatars correctly shaped and sized, with a steadier layout across screen sizes
Book progress percentages stay upright and centered inside their progress rings
Voice-requested deletion of a saved gem, memory, word or chapter now requires exact-item confirmation; deleting a chapter also protects the last chapter
Completely redesigned Profile and Settings, with a new identity card, companion picker, theme and voice choosers and storage meter
In a reading session the mascot now shows a short note when something happens, and tapping it opens a list of everything done so far
Report status timeline now shows the time (IST) and the date of each later stage
The streak card has a lively animated flame
The refresh button inside a report now refreshes that report
Home and Report an issue now scroll fully past the bottom bar, and the header and tabs stay pinned
New page snapshot mode: share a photo of your page once, keep the phone beside you and just ask about any word, phrase or sentence. Share the next page when you turn it
A new world-class Library book tile
Special Major Update style for release notes
Redesigned Your Reports with a status timeline and a single resolution note
New designs for the Home cards, the streak card and the Gems this week card, with tighter, even spacing
Cleaner Home screen when there is no book
Clear, friendly messages and a checking animation now appear whenever the voice service, microphone, camera or connection has a problem
The welcome tour is shorter, has a Skip button, and now explains the snapshot option. The tour no longer plays silently if the voice is unavailable
A redesigned developer card in About, and an app that no longer zooms in and out like a web page
If one voice key stops working, the app now quietly switches to another one instead of staying silent
Gem illustrations no longer contain stray, garbled lettering
Screenshots attached to a report now open full screen when you tap them
Fixed reading sessions getting stuck on "Getting ready" or "Reconnecting" when the voice service was busy
A friendly card now tells you when a new version is ready, with what has changed
A red number appears on Profile and Settings while an update is waiting
Choose Later and the card shows where to update any time: Profile, Settings, Check for updates
Fixed the welcome tour voice and reading sessions failing to connect when the app had been idle
Issue reports now keep retrying until they are delivered instead of staying queued

releases.title: Clearer issue tickets and smoother navigation

items.text: Issue reports now have a clear ticket number, with screenshots grouped by report type and labeled for easier developer review
Check for app updates from Settings, see what changed, and install when you are ready
Improved issue-report readability in both light and dark themes
Kept section headings and the Home welcome area visible while scrolling

releases.title: Smarter issue tracking and a smoother welcome

items.text: Attach screenshots to issue reports and view them alongside the report details
Follow issue progress from submission and review through testing and completion
Explore release history in Settings with a dedicated timeline for app updates
Fixed a welcome-tour issue that could prevent returning readers from reaching the app
Added website analytics to help us understand visits and improve Reading Companion
Live reading companion with Hindi and Odia vocabulary support
Gems, memory, and chapter tracking saved entirely on-device
Progressive Web App install flow and update notifications ready
